title: Polish-Style Stir Fry
description: A classic Polish dish made with wholesome ingredients and a simple stir-fry method.

ingredients.name: Polish sausage
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with a vegetarian sausage alternative

ingredients.name: Whole wheat rice
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of rice, but whole wheat is recommended for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of vegetable oil for frying

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of onion you prefer

ingredients.name: Bell pepper
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of bell pepper you prefer

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of tomato you prefer

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of garlic you prefer

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of salt you prefer

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of black pepper you prefer

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the cooked rice and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
